senses.gloss: m. (נקף) knocker, or borrower, an opprobrious epithet for a sort of sanctimonious Pharisees.
units: <cite ref="Sotah 22b:3">Sot. 22ᵇ</cite>, v. <cite ref="N01233"><he>נָקַף</he> I</cite>; Y. ib. V, 20ᶜ bot.; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 9:5:7">Y. Ber. IX, 14ᵇ</cite> bot., v. <cite ref="N01235"><he>נְקַף</he> II</cite>.
